title: The Bottleneck Is Retrieval, Not Reading: Diagnosing Evidence-Based Generation with RAG for Long Context Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.26951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is the dominant paradigm for grounding large language models in external corpora, but its similarity-driven, chunked pipeline has structural blind spots: it cannot anticipate which passages a question requires and discards document-level context that resolves cross-passage references. We introduce evidence-based generation (EBG), requiring models to return an answer with line-level citations, and a joint Ans+Evid metric that scores correctness and grounding simultaneously. translated_title: 瓶颈在于检索而非阅读：用基于证据的生成诊断面向长上下文问答的RAG
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）是将大语言模型与外部语料库相结合的主流范式，但其基于相似度的分块流水线存在结构性盲区：它无法预判问题需要哪些段落，并且会丢弃能够解决跨段落引用的文档级上下文。我们提出了基于证据的生成（EBG），要求模型在返回答案的同时提供行级引用，并设计了联合的Ans+Evid指标，可以同时评估答案的正确性与证据支撑度。我们将两个语料库重新构建为基于证据的多文档问答基准——MultiHop-RAG 和 QASPER-MP（QASPER 的多论文改编版本，带有真实场景中的短论文提示），并配以受控的合成两跳“大海捞针”测试，以及覆盖1万至100万字符的证据增强版 NoLiMa。在十个专有前沿大模型和三个开源权重大模型上的实验中，EBG 分离出了长上下文模型可以规避的两个 RAG 局限性：相似性检索……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于证据的生成（EBG）方法及 Ans+Evid 联合评估指标，通过构建多个多文档问答基准诊断发现：RAG 的瓶颈在于基于相似度的检索环节而非模型阅读，而这些检索局限正是长上下文模型所能规避的。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces evidence-based generation (EBG) with a joint Ans+Evid metric and multi-document QA benchmarks, diagnosing that the bottleneck in RAG lies in similarity-based retrieval rather than reading—limitations that long-context models can avoid.
